title: Towards Fair and Explainable AI using a Human-Centered AI Approach

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated across tabular datasets using group and individual fairness metrics (e.g., Statistical Parity Difference, False Negative/Positive Rate differences), measured in word embeddings using the Relative Norm Difference metric (cosine distance to group words), and assessed in creative writing via NLP-based tracking of character agency and descriptive stereotypes.

Measured on tabular datasets (e.g., COMPAS, Synthetic Hiring) using statistical classification fairness metrics, tracked in story character demographics using NLP, and evaluated in word embeddings using the Relative Norm Difference metric.
Assessed in tabular datasets (e.g., Bank Marketing, German Credit) using group and individual fairness metrics, and quantified in word embeddings via the Relative Norm Difference metric.
Evaluated in word embeddings by computing the Relative Norm Difference metric using cosine distance to religion-specific group words (e.g., comparing Islam vs. Christianity).
Measured in word embeddings by calculating the Relative Norm Difference metric using economic-status group words (e.g., comparing Rich vs. Poor associations).
